the development of a new Monte Carlo technique that is capable of simulating the nuclear medium at the level of a realistic many-body Hamiltonian.
the development of a consistent semiclassical approach to the study of Fermi gases in the presence of correlations, and its application to the study of nuclei.
the simulation of Fermi systems using a semiclassical approach.
